title: It’s cute, but…..
text: It’s cute, but…... I hate to return this; it’s so cute. But it catches on the carpet, and then can’t budge. The handle keeps falling off too, which can be fixed, but the getting caught in the carpet makes keeping it just impossible. Also, the reviewer who wrote that the brush (center) didn’t reach the floor is correct—it stayed perfectly clean! Outside of that it’s easy to empty, and living in a small house I always look for things that are easy to store and, this would’ve fit the bill.
